title: Payment cache rollback
summary: Cached payment status became stale after a rollout.
context: Response caching was introduced for read-heavy endpoints.
root_cause: Cache invalidation was not aligned with payment-state transitions.
lessons: Correctness-sensitive state needs explicit invalidation design before caching.

title: Queue retry storm
summary: A downstream timeout caused aggressive retries and queue growth.
context: Retry policy was changed while a provider dependency was unstable.
root_cause: Retry policy amplified a transient dependency failure.
lessons: Retry policies can amplify partial outages.

title: Database migration pause
summary: Migration was paused after lock contention increased request latency.
context: Large table migration overlapped with peak traffic.
root_cause: Migration window overlapped with high-write traffic.
lessons: Historical traffic shape matters as much as migration type.

title: Authentication deploy rollback
summary: A token validation change caused intermittent 401 responses.
context: Validation logic and token issuer config changed together.
root_cause: Two coupled changes made attribution difficult and exposed an issuer mismatch.
attempted_fixes: rolled back validation change|verified issuer setting
lessons: Avoid coupling unrelated authentication changes in one rollout.

title: Search index drift
summary: Search results lagged behind source-of-truth updates.
context: Incremental indexing was enabled after a bulk reindex.
root_cause: Cursor checkpointing skipped a subset of update events.
lessons: Index freshness requires durable checkpoint reconciliation.

title: Feature flag mismatch
summary: A feature flag was enabled for one service but not its dependent service.
context: Deployment order was changed to shorten release time.
root_cause: Cross-service rollout assumptions were not encoded as a dependency.
lessons: Feature flags need dependency-aware rollout checks.

title: Webhook duplication
summary: A consumer processed some webhook events twice.
root_cause: Acknowledgement moved past side-effect boundary without idempotency guarantee.
lessons: Side effects need idempotency when acknowledgment is delayed.

title: Memory leak under report load
summary: Long-running report jobs caused memory growth.
context: A new CSV export path retained large in-memory objects.
root_cause: Large intermediate objects remained referenced across requests.
lessons: Large exports should be streamed and bounded.

title: Cache warmup success
summary: A bounded cache warmup reduced cold-start latency without stale reads.
context: Only immutable product metadata was cached.
root_cause: The dataset was immutable during the request lifetime.
lessons: Cache safety depends on data mutability, not cache technology alone.

title: Dependency timeout partial
summary: A notification provider slowdown caused delayed delivery but no data loss.
context: Timeout and queue limits were unchanged from baseline.
root_cause: Provider latency exceeded consumer timeout but buffering protected data.
lessons: Buffering changes failure mode from loss to delay; measure both.

title: Tracing overload
summary: A verbose tracing configuration increased request overhead in staging.
context: Tracing cardinality increased with a new dynamic attribute.
root_cause: Telemetry dimensions multiplied event volume beyond the expected rate.
lessons: Observability changes need volume estimates and guardrails.

title: Payment retry correction
summary: Retry logic was changed to avoid duplicate charge attempts.
context: Past incidents showed retries were amplified by provider timeouts.
root_cause: Historical incidents linked aggressive retries with duplicate side effects.
lessons: Use historical failure chains to constrain future retry design.
